S2: - Examination: Sensation intact in left lower extremity.
S3: - Patient Education and Counseling: I encouraged her to keep her appointment with ophthalmology for her diabetic eye exam.

S14: - Medical Reasoning: She is doing well with Norvasc.
S15: - Examination: Pulses are normal in left lower extremity.
S16: A refill was sent for this today.

S18: Continue with ice and elevation.

S20: - Medical Reasoning: This appears to be well controlled with her current regimen.
S21: We will place her in an air splint and have her ambulate with crutches to avoid weightbearing until we get the x-ray results.
S22: - General Examination: No bruits.
S23: - Patient Education and Counseling: I advised the patient that I will contact her with the results of her x-ray, and that if these reveal a fracture, we will put in a referral to orthopedics for further evaluation.

S25: - Examination of the left ankle: Tender to palpation over the lateral malleolus and fifth metatarsal.
